title: Drug Release Time Point Testing
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Transfer 24‑well to 96‑well quadrant
steps.instruction: Perform the custom plate filling by transferring contents from a 24‑well source plate into one quadrant of a 96‑well destination plate.

steps.title: Input protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required protocol parameters in the provided fields of the OT App.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the custom labware files (JSON extensions) to upload.

steps.title: Upload Python protocol file
steps.instruction: In the Protocol tab of the OT App, upload the protocol script file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck per deck map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck hardware (labware, tip racks, pipette) exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the labware, tip rack, and pipette; refer to support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the protocol.
